answer.summary: Docker build failed while copying a base image layer from the quay.io CDN (httpReadSeeker: failed open / failed to do request). This is a registry/network fetch error during cache key computation, before any project code was compiled or tested, so it is unrelated to the frontend expectation changes. Re-running the job should likely pass.
